这是一个非常简单的 ComfyUI 初学者友好的 WAN VACE Cleaner & Tweaker 工作流程，它将与单个 WAN VACE GGUF 模型一起使用来清理和调整现有图像（这对于文本、徽标、水印、伪像等对象删除很有用，其中常规的修复和修复工作流程适合添加或编辑内容。通过对此工作流程的一些修改，您也可以使用它从视频中删除对象。如果您需要其他修复/修复/编辑的方法，您可以也可以在我的 CivitAI 个人资料中找到它们）。您需要一个 Hugging Face 帐户来下载必要的 WAN VACE 模型文件（详细信息如下）。确保使用 ComfyUI 管理器为 ComfyUI 安装 GGUF 插件，并将正确的文件放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的 SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、SD 3.5、HiDream、QWEN Image 和 通量。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需先选择您想要的 WAN VACE GGUF 型号，然后加载

#2.然后在“加载蒙版图像”上加载蒙版图像（如果您想将其与 ComfyUI 的蒙版编辑器一起使用，您也可以在此处加载原始图像进行蒙版）

＃3。现在可以调整输出分辨率设置（默认值适合肖像）

＃4。之后你可以去“清理参数”写下你的输出的正向和负向提示。 （默认值适用于大多数情况）

＃5。最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

** 您还可以加载原始未屏蔽图像以在可选查看窗格上查看并将其与经过清理和调整的输出进行比较。

享受吧！

### 要使用此工作流程，您需要登录 Huggingface 并从那里下载必要的文件（我还在包含工作流程文件的存档中包含了一个文本文件，您可以在其中找到更多关于我的其他工作流程的基本下载的链接）-

o.en:
This is a very simple ComfyUI beginner friendly WAN VACE Cleaner & Tweaker workflow that will work with a single WAN VACE GGUF model to cleanup and tweak your existing image (this is good for text, logo, watermark, artifacts etc. object removal, where regular inpainting & outpainting workflows are good for adding or editing stuffs. With some modifications of this workflow you can use it to remove objects from videos too. If you need other other methods of inpainting / outpaint / editing you can find them in my CivitAI profile too ). You need a Hugging Face account to download your necessary WAN VACE model files (Details are mentioned below). Make sure you install GGUF addon for ComfyUI using ComfyUI manager and place the correct files in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, SD 3.5, HiDream, QWEN Image and Flux.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired WAN VACE GGUF model first and then load

#2. then load your masked image on "Load Masked Image" (if you want to use it with ComfyUI's Mask Editor you can load your original image for masking here too)

#3. now can adjust output resolution settings (defaults are good for portraits)

#4. after this you can go to "Cleanup Parameter" write your positive and negative prompts for output. (defaults are good for most cases)

#5. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

** You can also load your original unmasked image to view and compare it with cleaned & tweaked output on an optional viewing pane.

Enjoy!

### To use this workflow you need to log into huggingface and download necessary files from there (I also included a text file on the archive that has the workflow file, in which you will find even more links for essential downloads for my other workflows) -
